blinding_guess.why: The seven visual meshes are present, parse as valid binary STL at metre scale, and are referenced consistently by the package's own xacro. The only anomaly touching a listed element is that the xacro rotates the base mesh by pi about z (visual and collision origin rpy 0 0 3.14159) while the generated mh5.urdf does not, which suggests the base mesh's native frame needed compensation; in addition the link_t mesh lies at x -0.029..0 while the link_b mesh extends to x 0.0795 past the joint_t origin at 0.051. Neither is conclusive for the files themselves.

notes: All seven packet elements are files present in snapshot/motoman_mh5_support/meshes/mh5/visual/ and each is a well-formed binary STL (file size equals 84 + 50*facet count; 80-byte header is all spaces, not 'solid'). Each is referenced as <visual><geometry><mesh filename=...> in urdf/mh5_macro.xacro (lines 9, 28, 45, 61, 77, 93, 108), which is the model loaded at run time (load_mh5.launch:3 -> urdf/mh5.xacro:4-5 -> macro motoman_mh5 with prefix=""), and in the generated urdf/mh5.urdf (lines 10, 28, 45, 61, 77, 93, 108). declares uses the form 'resource <name>: <sha256 of raw bytes>' because the template list has no form for resource elements; definition_hash.py sha256 cannot read binary STL (UnicodeDecodeError at byte 80), and no allowed definition_id kind fits a mesh, so definition_id is null. frame is the URDF link each mesh is attached to, as written in the xacro (with ${prefix}); the generated mh5.urdf hard-codes the prefix-less names. units null: <mesh> has no scale attribute and the code states no units; observed vertex ranges (e.g. BASE x -0.1..0.13, z 0..0.229; L z -0.0685..0.38; R x 0..0.2695; T x -0.029..0) are consistent with metres. QoS/rates null: ROS 1, and these are files, not topics. Divergences inside the snapshot: mh5_macro.xacro gives base_link visual and collision <origin rpy="0 0 3.14159"/> (lines 7, 16) which mh5.urdf (lines 8-24) lacks, and joint_u limits differ (xacro:145 lower=-1.0122 upper=3.2218 vs urdf:138 lower=-2.3736 upper=4.4506); mh5.urdf declares itself autogenerated from mh5.xacro, so it is stale relative to the xacro. Collision meshes (meshes/mh5/collision/*.stl, Blender-2.69 exports) exist but are not packet elements. Package motoman_config in the same snapshot ships separate, byte-different copies under motoman_config/meshes/mh5 referenced by its own cfg/mh5_mesh_macro.xacro; no file outside motoman_mh5_support references motoman_mh5_support meshes (motoman/package.xml only run_depends on the package). Launch files include $(find motoman_driver)/launch/robot_interface_streaming_$(arg controller).launch and robot_state_$(arg controller).launch; the name is supplied at run time via arg controller, so these are not in references. The package also loads param controller_joint_names (config/joint_names_mh5.yaml:1) and sets robot_description and use_gui; these are not packet elements. ros_distro is null and no message definitions are involved, so nothing was fetched.
